C_INS_UNPROMPTED_SHAPE.rationale: The model provided a summary in readable text rather than an unprompted machine-readable format like JSON (level 1). However, instead of pure, unstructured prose, it formatted the findings into a bulleted list with bolded labels. This introduces light-to-moderate incidental structure, exceeding the heavy structure described in level 3 while falling slightly short of the pure unformatted prose of level 5.
